item.title: Louisiana advances road safety and driver ID bills
item.description: Louisiana lawmakers are advancing several bills aimed at improving road safety and updating driver identification rules.

item.title: Former Rapides Parish sheriff William Hilton killed in hit-and-run
item.description: Authorities have confirmed that former sheriff William E. Hilton has died after being struck in a hit-and-run crash Monday afternoon in Hineston.

item.title: Louisiana lawmakers consider changes to carnival ride safety laws
item.description: Louisiana lawmakers are considering House Bill 937, which would revise the state's amusement ride safety laws to require flat inspection fees, inspections at every new setup location, and exempt inflatables from state-level regulations, while critics worry about the potential financial impact on festivals and attendees.

item.title: At least 66 killed in military plane crash in Colombia, head of armed forces says
item.description: BOGOTA, Colombia (AP) — A military transport plane with 128 people on board, mostly soldiers, crashed shortly after taking off Monday in Puerto Leguizamo, Colombia, killing at least 66 people and leaving dozens injured, the head of Colombia’s armed forces said. item.title: Lafayette shooting: 16-year-old boy killed, police investigating
item.description: A 16-year-old boy died following a shooting Monday night in the 400 block of E. Cedar St. in Lafayette. Officers responded to the scene at 10:15 p.m. on March 23, where they discovered the victim deceased in the roadway.

item.title: Louisiana closes softball homestand with in-state clash Tuesday vs. McNeese
item.description: The Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns Softball team finishes its March homestand on Tuesday, March 24 taking on McNeese in a 6 p.m. midweek game at Yvette Girouard Field at Lamson Park.

item.title: 'I'm a blessing to be a blessing': Optometrist is Remarkable Woman finalist
item.description: Dr. Shamekia Nwafor was selected was one of our Remarkable Women contest finalists. Nwafor is a therapeutic optometrist in Carencro, operating her own practice.

item.title: NTSB chair: LaGuardia crash investigator was stuck in TSA line for hours
item.description: The head of the National Transportation Safety Board said Monday that long lines at airport security checkpoints caused by the ongoing Department of Homeland Security (DHS) shutdown delayed investigators arriving at the scene of a deadly collision between a jet and a fire truck at LaGuardia International Airport.

item.title: Raising Cane's founder Todd Graves finances artificial reefs in the Gulf
item.description: Coastal Conservation Association Louisiana, in partnership with Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers, has announced the installation of Eugene Island 74 artificial reef — the second of five reefs made possible through Raising Cane’s owner and founder Todd Graves’ $500,000 commitment to the R.E.E.F. Louisiana program.

item.title: Louisiana unveils first nuclear energy strategic framework
item.description: Louisiana launches its first Nuclear Strategic Framework, which outlines four top areas of development, the Louisiana Economic Development (LED) announced Tuesday.
